methods.description: Because Hady's biking speed > Jasmine's, he should do more walking

methods.description: Jasmine's walking distance = Hady's biking distance and vice versa

methods.name: Diagrams
methods.description: Accurate diagram showing distances, speeds, partition point

methods.name: LCM/HCF method
methods.description: Use LCM of biking speeds to find distance factor
methods.why_fails: LCM (600) doesn't divide remaining distance (5000) completely

methods.name: Ratios method
methods.description: Divide total distance using ratio of speeds
methods.why_fails: Walking speed ratio (5:3) ≠ biking speed ratio (4:3) — non-additive property

methods.name: Trial and Error A (brute force)
methods.description: Guess partition point, compute times, increment systematically

methods.name: Trial and Error B (ratio-informed)
methods.description: Start guess from ratio method result, then increment

methods.description: Set up equations with x and y but more variables than equations
